description: HP-74 is the Registration and Licensing Authority (R&LA) located in Bhoranj, serving the Hamirpur district of Himachal Pradesh. Operating under the local Sub-Divisional Magistrate, this office manages vehicle registrations, driving license issuances, and transport permit renewals for the Bhoranj subdivision.
address: Office of the Sub Divisional Officer (Civil), Bhoranj, District Hamirpur, Himachal Pradesh
